title: The Indwelling of the Spirit
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The indwelling of the Spirit means that the Holy Spirit lives in believers as the personal presence of God. Every true believer belongs to Christ and is made God’s dwelling place by the Spirit.
summary: The indwelling of the Spirit means that the Holy Spirit lives in believers as the personal presence of God. Every true believer belongs to Christ and is made God’s dwelling place by the Spirit.
christFocus: Christ does not leave His people as orphans. Through the indwelling Spirit, believers share in the life, presence, comfort, and power of the risen Lord.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit is not merely near believers; He dwells in them. Scripture teaches that anyone who does not have the Spirit of Christ does not belong to Him. The indwelling Spirit is a mark of true belonging to Christ.

The indwelling of the Spirit makes believers temples of God. This is both a comfort and a calling. God’s people are not spiritually abandoned, and their bodies and lives are not their own to use for sin.

The Spirit’s indwelling also unites believers together as God’s dwelling place. The church is built into a holy temple in the Lord, not because of buildings or programs, but because God dwells among His people by the Spirit.

This doctrine does not mean believers become divine or self-sufficient. It means God graciously gives His presence to His people so they may live in faith, holiness, love, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers feel abandoned, powerless, or spiritually alone. The indwelling Spirit speaks a better word: God is present with His people from within, not merely watching from a distance.

This doctrine also confronts careless living. Because believers are temples of the Holy Spirit, their bodies, desires, speech, relationships, and habits matter before God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as one in whom the Spirit of God dwells. Do not treat your body, mind, or choices as though they belong to you alone. Draw comfort from God’s presence, resist sin by His power, and remember that your life is now a dwelling place for the Holy Spirit.
